# The Bohemians Festival 2026

> A boutique music & travel festival set in Sfântu Gheorghe, Danube Delta, Romania — right where the river meets the sea. 3rd edition. 18–21 June 2026. Limited to ~500 attendees. Organised by Cyclic Agency.

## About

The Bohemians is a four-day, four-night electronic music festival in one of the most remote and wild places in Europe: Sfântu Gheorghe, at the end of the oldest arm of the Danube, where the river flows into the Black Sea. The village is only accessible by boat. The festival brings together a curated crowd of 500 people to celebrate music, nature, and community. No compromise on the lineup. No mass-market approach.

## Key Facts

- **Full name:** The Bohemians — Music & Travel Festival 2026
- **Edition:** 3rd (previous editions: 2024, 2025)
- **Dates:** 18–21 June 2026
- **Location:** Sfântu Gheorghe, Delta Dunării (Danube Delta), Tulcea County, Romania
- **Coordinates:** 44.8967° N, 29.5978° E
- **Capacity:** ~500 attendees
- **Access:** Boat only — from Murighiol or Tulcea (45–90 min ride)
- **Minimum age:** 18
- **Organiser:** Cyclic Agency — Director: Ionuț Hupca — ionut@cyclic.ro
- **Ticket platform:** Kompostor (https://www.kompostor.ro/evenimente/13591-the-bohemias-music-travel-festival-2026)
- **Website:** https://thebohemiansociety.ro

## Accommodation

Ticket does not include accommodation. Booking code: **Bohemian** · Period: 18–22 June 2026

- **Green Village Resort** — 4-star resort, pool, restaurant — https://www.greenresort.eu/ron/
- **Green Dolphin — Wooden Houses** — 55 authentic wooden cabins — https://www.dolphincamping.ro/en/
- **Green Dolphin Camping** — 500 tent spots on the waterfront — https://www.dolphincamping.ro/en/

## How to Get There

1. By car or bus to **Murighiol** or **Tulcea**
2. Then by boat to **Sfântu Gheorghe** (45–90 minutes)
- Eurolines runs direct coaches to Murighiol from Bucharest

## Activities

- Guided boat excursions through the Delta's canals
- SUP (stand-up paddleboarding) on calm lakes
- Village walk through Sfântu Gheorghe fishing village
- Wild beach and Black Sea sunsets
